title: doronicum plantagineum subsp. atlanticum
intro: Doronicum plantagineum subsp. atlanticum, commonly known as Atlantic Leopard's Bane, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the Iberian Peninsula and western France. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Atlantic Leopard's Bane include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
